name: Kinetic Slam
description: Four words slam in one per beat at full-frame size, each knocking the last back; then the line assembles with a final accent word, a warm bloom and a damped camera shake on every impact.
move: Four words slam in one per beat at full-frame size, each knocking the last back; then the line assembles with a final accent word, a warm bloom and a damped camera shake on every impact.
how: Deterministic draw(t). Each slam drops from 2.3× scale through an 18px blur on Flow expoOut in 0.32s (an impact is meant to arrive hard). Camera shake sums seeded damped sinusoids per impact. The bloom is a radial accent glow with a two-frame smoothstep attack. The line exits as one unit so words never collide.
adapt: Edit the solo words, final line and BEATS to your track's tempo. Placeholder copy is generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Pure draw(t): mount the markup in the shot and call draw from the film's frame hook with shot-local time; wait for fonts before measuring.
caveats: Original implementation of the "Kinetic type slam" motion-design idea; no third-party preset, kit or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
